about: Mixpanel-internal event property keys found in Mixpanel's own raw export. filterMixpanelNoise deletes every 'drop' key from event properties before import and counts every 'watch' key and 'watch_events' name it sees, without changing them. A key moves into 'drop' only with a code reference into Mixpanel's source or a sandbox reproduction. Evidence paths are relative to the Mixpanel analytics repo at 0bbc6a46c0e.

drop.why: The query readers hide an event carrying it until identity management confirms the id remaps to the event's own distinct_id. That remap exists only in the source project, so in any other project the event is hidden from every query, forever. /import still counts it as imported.
drop.evidence: backend/libquery/arb_bin/reader.c:183-237; backend/libquery/brb/reader_v2/filters/global_distinct_id_filter.cpp:82-148; staging reproduction: 5,902,970 hidden events restored by re-sending without the key

watch.why: Written by the reshuffle writer. No query or identity reader reads it. Candidate for drop pending a sandbox test.
